probe: What are we measuring when it seems everyone else has "figured it out"?
premise: Other people's external milestones mean they have achieved internal certainty.

pairs.reflection: idk. like job titles i guess? people on linkedin are all "excited to announce" they're a senior something or whatever. and ppl from uni have houses and stuff now. i just feel behind them
pairs.reply: When someone announces a new title or buys a house, what tells you they have figured out their life?

pairs.reflection: idk maybe it doesnt tell me anything really. it just looks like they know where theyre going and i dont. like they picked a thing and stuck with it
pairs.reply: When it looks like someone has picked a thing and stuck with it, does that show certainty on the inside, or just movement on the outside?

pairs.reflection: idk. outside i guess, thats all i can see. but they probably feel more sure than i do. like my parents have always just known they were gonna be doctors so thats kind of what i think of
pairs.reply: When you think of your parents having "always just known," are you measuring your inside against their outside, or against their certainty?

pairs.reflection: idk, that's kind of a confusing question. i guess their certainty? but i dont actually know what theyd say if i asked them. i never did
pairs.reply: Leave your parents and LinkedIn aside for a moment. Right now, without comparing yourself to anyone else, what does "figured it out" mean to you?

pairs.reflection: idk. just like knowing what you want to do i guess. and not being bored of it after a year. i dont really know how to answer that without comparing tbh
pairs.reply: If a friend had the house and the senior title, but told you they felt completely lost inside, would you say they have figured it out?

pairs.reflection: idk. probably not? like if they said that i'd be surprised honestly. but i think id still kind of think theyd be ok, cause they have the house and everything
pairs.reply: We wondered whether underneath this is an assumption that having those milestones on the outside means someone must have figured it out on the inside. Does that fit, or not?

pairs.reflection: yeah i guess that fits. like the house and the title just look like being ok to me. idk if thats actually true tho
pairs.reply: If the milestones don't actually tell you whether someone has figured it out, what are you left measuring yourself against?

event.openQuestion: If the milestones don't actually tell you whether someone has figured it out, what are you left measuring yourself against?
